channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 07
item.description:
7 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

Bug Fixes

  • Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
  • DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 06
item.description:
54 development commits

Gear & Equipment

  • Night Vision Goggles no longer get stuck and work reliably for night vision.
  • Scientists' suit eyes now glow correctly after trophy head unload.
  • Flamethrower fuel gauge now accurately tracks fuel and includes a subtle needle wobble animation.

Base Building & Respawn

  • Sleeping bags cannot be placed or respawn in spaces too tight for a player; a warning toast appears on invalid placement.

Inventory & Crafting

  • Backpack contents are now considered for mission item checks, tech tree unlocks, vending machine purchases, and other requirements (crafting, building, and weapon reloads still ignore backpacks).
  • The “cannot learn” tooltip for disabled blueprints is restored, explaining why a blueprint is unavailable.
  • Watercatcher and chicken coop trough loot panels now automatically select the appropriate bucket, speeding up collection.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where painting quickly with the tablet pen would cause strokes to break into dots.
  • Fixed a bug where IO wires would occasionally appear oversized while using the wire tool.
  • Fixed shutter frames appearing in the wrong state when entering network range.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Elongated distance flares now persist longer, extending visual range for signaling and spotting.
  • Floating City flares brightness reduced, improving visibility and reducing glare.
